text: {"lessons":["After building a diversified set of holdings, staying invested without reacting to every monthly move let me participate in the recovery; I should avoid unnecessary trading.","My account rose from about 95,731 in Period 6 to 109,510 in Period 10 without further trades, but a short rally does not prove my approach will always work.","Before buying or selling, check how the trade fits my ten-year apartment goal, overall diversification, and available cash rather than chasing recent gains or trying to speed up growth."]}
